title: ID0468841-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002722] Unexpected token 'B', ..."HoldTime":BUS0_RX_Ap"... is not valid JSON
description:
Reported Behaviour/ Issue:
Unexpected token 'B', ..."HoldTime":BUS0_RX_Ap"... is not valid JSON
Solution: Needs to be addressed to R&D when SECC logs are available. They must be collected during a short period of time after the error otherwise they are lost.

Hello,
A customer tried to charge yesterday 19th of December on the charger n. 170002722 thru Type 2 plug. The recharge was automatically interrupted after 20 minutes.
Is it possible to check logs on the charger 170002722 on yesterday 19th of December between 2:52:09 p.m. and 3:13:53 p.m. (CU Time) ?
Thank you in advance

As my colleague said, this is the root cause of the problem. For us to troubleshoot and analyse, we need to check a specific set of logs that are only available during a short period of time.
I tried to get them but unsucessfully.
If you find this behaviour again, please report back to us and we will immediately get the logs so that we can find a solution.
Since there is nothing we can do here, I will close the ticket.
I apologise for the trouble and have a lovely holiday season.
Best regards,
Francisco
